en: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.
What do you want, adventurer? I'm running late, and my employer doesn't look kindly on tardiness.
Yes, I am. What's it to you?
The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a wreckless fool.
Elder Highpeak watches over the Hinterlands from a hill near its center.

You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.
Ah yes, another who will stoke the fires and forge the weapons of war. Of course I will teach you how.
Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.
Hello, Adventurer. If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies. To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

Our ancient lands are in the northeast of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and offers many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately, its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity, but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.
Greetings. Our bats are well trained and fed. You'll not find faster.

My family worked the Northridge Lumber Mill in what's now Western Plaguelands. They were dedicated to the Dumah family, and now the Scarlet Crusade have taken it over along with all of Hearthglen!

I will not rest until those zealots are wiped from Azeroth.
My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse. The Deathstalkers need your help.
Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...
